title: 耳のお手入れは丁寧に

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Grass, about this afternoon…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are, King! This way, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Wow, Urara. Is this the famed ear-cleaning maestro?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …Ear-cleaning maestro?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yup! King is super awesome at making your ears nice and clean!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: She always gives my ears a good brushy brush. I feel all wobbly when she's done, like jello!

text_block_list.name: Younger Students
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! Could you do that for us too?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I-I mean… all I'm doing is basic upkeep and care! Isn't that right, Grass?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why are you asking for my opinion?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Because I'm talking about normal ear cleaning routines here. After a light brushing…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I lightly pat everything down with a well-squeezed moist towel. I make sure to use warm water for the towel since Urara becomes jumpy if it's cold.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then I dry off the last of the water with a soft, dry towel. That's when I use the professional cotton swab made just for ears…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my. How thorough.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Thorough?! This is normal! Urara is always skipping steps so I have to spend extra time teaching her the right way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The ears are a very important organ. They process our auditory senses, but also help us keep balance. Proper ear care is the first step to winning.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're very much in your element, King. However…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass! You know where my ear pick is?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you lose it again? How many does that make now?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hm… I'm not sure?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I think I normally lose one a month! C'mon, Grass, lemme borrow yours!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Eek! U-uh, you know I was just kidding, right? Hehe… I'll just find a twig somewhere and make do…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, El! Why would you resort to that?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How can you be so reckless? Although… I suppose I've seen stranger.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh, didn't see you there, King! And what's everyone else doing here… Are you settin' up wrestling brackets?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nope, nope. Everyone's here to get their ears cleaned by King!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hmm… Why don't you line up too? Apparently, the sensation is enough to send you to heaven.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: For real?! King, would you clean my ears too?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now you, El?! Honestly…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll go get my tools! You all stay put!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Kaaay!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Experience is the best teacher, they say.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Perhaps, if El gets a taste of luxury, her standards toward self-care will change for the better.
